audit_status.source_base: Greek Gospel text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for brothers, Booths feast, hiddenness, temple teaching, judgment, origin dispute, officers, living water, Spirit note, division, Nicodemus.

verses.restored: After these things Jesus was walking in Galilee, for he did not want to walk in Judea because the Judeans were seeking to kill him.

familiar.text: After these things Jesus walked in Galilee: for he would not walk in Jewry, because the Jews sought to kill him.

verses.restored: Now the Judean feast of Booths was near.

familiar.text: Now the Jews’ feast of tabernacles was at hand.

verses.restored: His brothers therefore said to him, Depart from here and go into Judea, so that your disciples also may behold your works that you do.

familiar.text: His brethren therefore said unto him, Depart hence, and go into Judaea, that thy disciples also may see the works that thou doest.

verses.restored: For no one does anything in hiddenness while seeking to be in openness. If you do these things, reveal yourself to the world.

familiar.text: For there is no man that doeth any thing in secret, and he himself seeketh to be known openly. If thou do these things, shew thyself to the world.

verses.restored: For not even his brothers were trusting into him.

familiar.text: For neither did his brethren believe in him.

verses.restored: Jesus therefore says to them, My time is not yet present, but your time is always ready.

familiar.text: Then Jesus said unto them, My time is not yet come: but your time is alway ready.

verses.restored: The world is not able to hate you; but it hates me, because I bear witness concerning it that its works are harmful.

familiar.text: The world cannot hate you; but me it hateth, because I testify of it, that the works thereof are evil.

verses.restored: You go up to the feast. I am not yet going up to this feast, because my time has not yet been fulfilled.

familiar.text: Go ye up unto this feast: I go not up yet unto this feast: for my time is not yet full come.

verses.restored: Having said these things to them, he remained in Galilee.

familiar.text: When he had said these words unto them, he abode still in Galilee.

verses.restored: But when his brothers went up to the feast, then he also went up, not openly but as in hiddenness.

familiar.text: But when his brethren were gone up, then went he also up unto the feast, not openly, but as it were in secret.

verses.restored: Therefore the Judeans were seeking him at the feast and saying, Where is that one?

familiar.text: Then the Jews sought him at the feast, and said, Where is he?

verses.restored: There was much murmuring about him among the crowds. Some said, He is good; others said, No, but he leads the crowd astray.

familiar.text: And there was much murmuring among the people concerning him: for some said, He is a good man: others said, Nay; but he deceiveth the people.

verses.restored: Yet no one spoke openly about him because of fear of the Judeans.

familiar.text: Howbeit no man spake openly of him for fear of the Jews.

verses.restored: When the feast was already halfway through, Jesus went up into the temple and began teaching.

familiar.text: Now about the midst of the feast Jesus went up into the temple, and taught.

verses.restored: The Judeans therefore marveled, saying, How does this one know writings, not having learned?

familiar.text: And the Jews marvelled, saying, How knoweth this man letters, having never learned?

verses.restored: Jesus answered them and said, My teaching is not mine, but the One's who sent me.

familiar.text: Jesus answered them, and said, My doctrine is not mine, but his that sent me.

verses.restored: If anyone wills to do that One's will, one will know concerning the teaching, whether it is from the Divine or whether I speak from myself.

familiar.text: If any man will do his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of God, or whether I speak of myself.

verses.restored: The one speaking from oneself seeks one's own glory; but the one seeking the glory of the One who sent him, this one is true, and injustice is not in him.

familiar.text: He that speaketh of himself seeketh his own glory: but he that seeketh his glory that sent him, the same is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.

verses.restored: Has not Moses given you the Law? Yet none of you does the Law. Why do you seek to kill me?

familiar.text: Did not Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keepeth the law? Why go ye about to kill me?

verses.restored: The crowd answered, You have a troubling spirit; who seeks to kill you?

familiar.text: The people answered and said, Thou hast a devil: who goeth about to kill thee?

verses.restored: Jesus answered and said to them, I did one work, and you all marvel.

familiar.text: Jesus answered and said unto them, I have done one work, and ye all marvel.

verses.restored: Because of this Moses has given you circumcision, not that it is from Moses but from the fathers, and on a Sabbath you circumcise a human.

familiar.text: Moses therefore gave unto you circumcision; (not because it is of Moses, but of the fathers;) and ye on the sabbath day circumcise a man.

verses.restored: If a human receives circumcision on Sabbath so that the Law of Moses may not be broken, are you angry with me because I made a whole human healthy on Sabbath?

familiar.text: If a man on the sabbath day receive circumcision, that the law of Moses should not be broken; are ye angry at me, because I have made a man every whit whole on the sabbath day?

verses.restored: Do not judge according to appearance, but judge the righteous/just judgment.

familiar.text: Judge not according to the appearance, but judge righteous judgment.

verses.restored: Some of the Jerusalemites therefore said, Is this not the one they seek to kill?

familiar.text: Then said some of them of Jerusalem, Is not this he, whom they seek to kill?

verses.restored: Look, he speaks openly, and they say nothing to him. Have the rulers truly known that this is the Messiah?

familiar.text: But, lo, he speaketh boldly, and they say nothing unto him. Do the rulers know indeed that this is the very Christ?

verses.restored: But we know where this one is from; when the Messiah comes, no one knows where he is from.

familiar.text: Howbeit we know this man whence he is: but when Christ cometh, no man knoweth whence he is.

verses.restored: Jesus therefore cried out in the temple, teaching and saying, You know me, and you know where I am from; yet I have not come from myself, but the One who sent me is true, whom you do not know.

familiar.text: Then cried Jesus in the temple as he taught, saying, Ye both know me, and ye know whence I am: and I am not come of myself, but he that sent me is true, whom ye know not.

verses.restored: I know that One, because I am from him, and that One sent me.

familiar.text: But I know him: for I am from him, and he hath sent me.

verses.restored: Therefore they were seeking to seize him, yet no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.

familiar.text: Then they sought to take him: but no man laid hands on him, because his hour was not yet come.

verses.restored: But many from the crowd trusted into him and were saying, When the Messiah comes, will he do more signs than this one has done?

familiar.text: And many of the people believed on him, and said, When Christ cometh, will he do more miracles than these which this man hath done?

verses.restored: The Pharisees heard the crowd murmuring these things about him, and the chief priests and Pharisees sent officers to seize him.

familiar.text: The Pharisees heard that the people murmured such things concerning him; and the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers to take him.

verses.restored: Jesus therefore said, Yet a little time I am with you, and I go to the One who sent me.

familiar.text: Then said Jesus unto them, Yet a little while am I with you, and then I go unto him that sent me.

verses.restored: You will seek me and will not find me; and where I am, you are not able to come.

familiar.text: Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come.

verses.restored: The Judeans therefore said to one another, Where is this one about to go, that we will not find him? Is he about to go to the dispersion among the Greeks and teach the Greeks?

familiar.text: Then said the Jews among themselves, Whither will he go, that we shall not find him? will he go unto the dispersed among the Gentiles, and teach the Gentiles?

verses.restored: What is this word that he said, You will seek me and will not find me, and where I am, you are not able to come?

familiar.text: What manner of saying is this that he said, Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come?

verses.restored: On the last day, the great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried out, saying, If anyone thirsts, let that one come to me and drink.

familiar.text: In the last day, that great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.

verses.restored: The one trusting into me, just as the Scripture said, rivers of living water will flow from within that one.

familiar.text: He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.

verses.restored: He said this concerning the Spirit, whom those trusting into him were about to receive; for Spirit was not yet given, because Jesus had not yet been glorified.

familiar.text: (But this spake he of the Spirit, which they that believe on him should receive: for the Holy Ghost was not yet given; because that Jesus was not yet glorified.)

verses.restored: Some from the crowd, hearing these words, were saying, This is truly the Prophet.

familiar.text: Many of the people therefore, when they heard this saying, said, Of a truth this is the Prophet.

verses.restored: Others were saying, This is the Messiah. But others said, Does the Messiah come from Galilee?

familiar.text: Others said, This is the Christ. But some said, Shall Christ come out of Galilee?

verses.restored: Has not the Scripture said that the Messiah comes from the seed of David and from Bethlehem, the village where David was?

familiar.text: Hath not the scripture said, That Christ cometh of the seed of David, and out of the town of Bethlehem, where David was?

verses.restored: Therefore division happened in the crowd because of him.

familiar.text: So there was a division among the people because of him.

verses.restored: Some of them wanted to seize him, but no one laid hands on him.

familiar.text: And some of them would have taken him; but no man laid hands on him.

verses.restored: The officers therefore came to the chief priests and Pharisees, and those said to them, Why did you not bring him?

familiar.text: Then came the officers to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said unto them, Why have ye not brought him?

verses.restored: The officers answered, Never has a human spoken like this.

familiar.text: The officers answered, Never man spake like this man.

verses.restored: The Pharisees therefore answered them, Have you also been led astray?

familiar.text: Then answered them the Pharisees, Are ye also deceived?

verses.restored: Has anyone from the rulers or from the Pharisees trusted into him?

familiar.text: Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed on him?

verses.restored: But this crowd that does not know the Law is cursed.

familiar.text: But this people who knoweth not the law are cursed.

verses.restored: Nicodemus, the one who had come to him earlier, being one of them, says to them,

familiar.text: Nicodemus saith unto them, (he that came to Jesus by night, being one of them,)

verses.restored: Does our Law judge a human unless it first hears from that one and knows what that one is doing?

familiar.text: Doth our law judge any man, before it hear him, and know what he doeth?

verses.restored: They answered and said to him, Are you also from Galilee? Search and see that no prophet arises from Galilee.

familiar.text: They answered and said unto him, Art thou also of Galilee? Search, and look: for out of Galilee ariseth no prophet.

verses.restored: [[Then each went to his own house. This verse begins the later textual tradition continued in 8:1-11.]]

familiar.text: And every man went unto his own house.
